notes.title: MASSIVE Zombies Update: Prison Map + New Zombies + BOSS BATTLE - Update: v0.23
notes.content:
This update brings many new additions to the Hood Zombies gamemode along with additions to the multiplayer gamemode. 

[b]Hood Zombies[/b]

[list]
[*] New Map: Detroit Penitentiary: This map is a massive prison featuring 4 unique cell blocks and a large area to roam and train. This map is nearly 4x the size as the abandoned school map and features a lot to explore
[*] New Zombie Variants: Hood Zombies difficulty is now increased, with new zombie variants spawning after higher rounds. Now there are red "fent" zombies that are faster and stronger and even higher level "fire" zombies that spawn after round 15. 
[*] 100+ New Zombies Voicelines: These voicelines will spawn for player actions and round endings, giving hints to find the secret of the map
[*] Fent Dragon Boss Battle: Find all of the fent pickups in the prison map to enable the fent reactor, a device that spawns the fent dragon. This dragon is very difficult and shoots explosive skull cannons at the players. You may need 4 players to beat the dragon
[*] +many more additions to the zombies gamemode
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased level cap, now level 50
[*] AK47-Bluefire: Unlocked at level 50, this high level skin features fire particles in the weapon animation.
[*] More minor bug fixes
[/list]

Even though this is mostly zombies update, the multiplayer mode will be getting some love in the next couple weeks

Stay tuned our [url=https://discord.gg/QMvfyX37X6]discord [/url] 

-Trap$tar

notes.title: Update 0.22 - Login Issue Addressed + Fixes + New Content Coming Soon
notes.content:
This patch update addresses the login problems that have been highlighted on by recent reviews and posts regarding the login system

[b]Updated Login[/b]
This new update allows you to pick between local steam login, and hood warfare account login upon first opening Hood Warfare. 

New users can log in with the local steam method to avoid having to create an account.
Old users can log in via the Hood Warfare account method and keep all of their progress.

Both login methods feature leveling and stats for kills, death, KDR. Users can switch between the Hood Warfare account and Local Steam profile account on the main menu via the logout button.

Prior to this update this was only able to be done by changing the version to the "nologin" version in steam settings, but now the local login works without needing to do this. 

This update also brings bug fixes and quality of life improvements such as:

[list]
[*] Updated menu
[*] Updated loadout selection character
[*] Doors now show on abandoned school multiplayer map
[*] Drive-Bys cost 5 kills instead of 3.
[*] Text on drive by unlock showing the key to activate it
[*] And many others.
[/list]

[b]Content Coming Soon...
[/b]Although there hasn't been many updates in the past few months, a major update featuring a new map and weapons will be coming soon. 

-Trap$tar

notes.title: New Mode & Quality of life v0.18
notes.content:
This update brings a new mode and various quality of life and bug fixes to Hood Warfare
[b][u]
New Mode: Gun Game[/u][/b]
You spawn with a pistol. Every 3 kills you progress to the next weapon until the final weapon, the shank. The first to get a kill with the shank wins.


[b][u]New Level Cap: Level 30[/u][/b]
Level 30 is now the max level in the game. There are no unlockables to this level yet but they will be coming soon.

[b][u]Full Controller Support (somewhat). [/u][/b]

The game is now completely navigable with a controller with the exception of the login screen. Which will require a keyboard to input username and password. A virtual cursor can be controlled with the left stick.

[b][u]Various Bug Fixes[/u][/b]

Fixed Vatos spawning in the Crips spawn
Slightly Nerfed Grenade
Made glock semi auto again. Different variations of the glock will be coming with future updates including a glock with a switch.
New scope for the sniper
Team modes are now 5 per team instead of 6. (6 was too chaotic and too much spawn killing)
Changed main menu a bit
Made the flashlight bigger on the mall map due to it being a dark map
Shooting your gun now cancels out running with auto sprint enabled. So you dont have to manually stop running to shoot. 
More small bug fixes


This is the first of many updates that will be comin soon so stay tuned

-Trap$tar

notes.title: Update v0.16 - The Project Baby Update Part I
notes.content:
The Project Baby Update Part I has arrived and it brings multiple new features to Hood Warfare


[b]New Map: Southside.
[/b]

This map takes place in the southside of Detroit in a hood neighborhood. Play all main gamemodes on this map.

[b]Controller Support Added
[/b]

Controller support has finally been added. Find the controls in the options menu. Menu navigation has not yet been implemented. But the game is now playable using a controller.

[b]
New Melee Weapon: Shank[/b]

The shank offers quick melee attacks at close range. This weapon offers increased attack speed over the bat at the cost of range

[b]Other Adjustments[/b]

Buffs and nerfs to various weapons. UZI got a slight buff. Glock can now be fired full auto. Other small quality of life improvements and adjustments to weapons.

Running is now toggled with shift or LS so you dont need to constantly hold it down to run.

Loading screen changed.

Other various bug fixes.

[b]Coming Soon[/b]

This is part one of the Project Baby Update. Part 2 will include various other additions and changes relating to the projects theme. See ya next update. Make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/QMvfyX37X6]Discord[/url] to stay up to date with changes.

-Trap$tar

notes.title: Update v0.014 - 2 New Maps - Detroit Mall and DowntownDetroit_v2
notes.content:
This update brings 2 brand new maps to the game, with the game now having a total of 8 maps.

Detroit Mall, a burning mall in Detroit. This map features a burning indoor mall with shops and a movie theater. Don't get too close to the fire! This map can be played on all base modes.

Downtown Detroit v2: This is a map exclusive to the round based game mode, Gang Warfare. This map is similar to the original downtown Detroit but features more detail and combat opportunity with many pathways and alleyways. It's also slightly smaller.

notes.title: Weapon Progression Update - v0.013
notes.content: This follow up update to the last patch brings many beautiful skins to all weapons in the game. These skins are not micro transactions and all are unlocked through play. All skins unlock after level 10 to max level 20, so some grinding may be needed to unlock these weapons. Grind some camos and see the new skins in game for yourself!

notes.title: Update v0.012 - New Map & Gun + Progression
notes.content:
Update v0.012 has just released and there is new content to be found in this update.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Brand new map for all base game modes: Chinatown - A map in the Detroit slums of the Chinatown district. Explore small corridors and stairwells in this close quarters map.
[*] New weapon: AK74-U (also known as the sawed off AK). Not to be confused with the AK, the AK74-U offers high damage and high fire rate at the cost of decreased range. It can be unlocked at level 8. The AK74 shares many similarities to the UZI. 
[*] Progression has been updated and players can now reach level 20, though it will require a lot of grinding. Currently, these new levels don't offer any unlocks however they will soon with new weapons and unlockable cosmetics. This update takes off the level 10 cap so players can grind to level 20 and instantly unlock the new items once they become available soon.
[*] Other bug fixes

[/list]

Cya next update thugs!

-Trap$tar
